learning_outcomes.text: Develop proposed solutions for heating and ventilation systems and installations for rooms and buildings.
Apply calculation methods and national and European standards and regulations for essential system components and systems in heating and ventilation technology.
Evaluate possibilities for using conventional or renewable energies.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of heating and ventilation technology
Introduction to national and European regulations
Air change in residential and non-residential buildings
Sound insulation, fire protection and hygiene in heating and ventilation systems
Types of heating systems and their components
Types of ventilation systems and their components
Selection of heating and ventilation systems and system components
Dimensioning of heating pipes and pipe network calculation
Dimensioning of ventilation ducts and pressure loss calculation
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination (Klausur) and the laboratory practical work or homework as a study achievement. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
